Actual encoded SAT iff retained-model plus private edge witness iff retained-model plus matching
Fresh edge IDs offset + Nat.pair(row,hole) satisfy injectivity and below-offset disjointness
Actual checked dual-Horn retained solver output reduces constructed CNF satisfiability to matching at its greatest model
Checked retained UNSAT excludes the constructed CNF
premises: Rows Fin r and holes Fin h with static finite neighbor sets
Explicit constructor adds retained F, guard-or-private-edge rows, and pairwise column exclusion clauses
Private edge-variable map injective on all row-hole pairs
All retained and guard literals disjoint from private IDs
Greatest-model output projection additionally requires positive guard literals and actual checkedSolve F = some (some T)
fresh_constructor: Fresh IDs are offset + Nat.pair(row.val,hole.val). All retained and guard variable IDs below offset suffice for disjointness; injectivity proved.
subtle_bridge: The encoder constrains only valid neighbor edges. Extraction masks all non-neighbor edge values false before invoking typed HasPrivateEdges, so absent edge clauses are not assumed.
significance: Connects previous typed matching and executable retained greatest-model proofs to the actual project CNF language. This is correctness of an explicit constructor, not an arbitrary-input recognizer.

next_research_target: Implement matching with a checked success/failure certificate and an executable fresh-variable witness lift. For arbitrary CNF inputs require a checked decomposition certificate/equality to the constructor; do not infer it from overlapping rows.
